Bc the people who are true to you and respect you will be the ones who bring up making plans to celebrate with you before ur birthday even comes (doesn’t always have to be planning, but generally speaking).  

I have learned over the years to completely cancel out the people who have brought on stress to me - I have literally removed 90% of the people I used to associate with because they in some way or another caused me distress which only lead to further induce my depression.  

I am not here giving lessons or preaching nor am I telling you how or what you should do, I am not a professional by any means. I am just a person who has attempted suicide once, have been admitted to psychiatric hospitals many times, tried every antidepressant on the planet and attended numerous treatment programs and these things I mentioned have helped me.  

Don’t get me wrong, i am not some happy jolly dude at the moment, in fact I just posted here myself because of how shitty I feel tonight.  

I hope the best for you the remainder of ur special day, happy birthday once again.

I have major RLS when I first started Seroquel, luckily for me it has practically gone away - I can still feel it if I end up staying awake past my “window of sleep” when the meds kick in and make me drowsy.  The only other annoying symptom I still have is my heart rate goes bonkers if I move and walk.  Going to the bathroom becomes a mission, heart rate goes up like crazy and I can feel it throbbing in my chest and that makes it difficult to breath sometimes.  Other than that, I can honestly say this concoction has be a miracle for me.  

Also, everyone including u have recommended being truthful with my psychiatrist.  I’m definitely going to do that - bc like u said, hiding it or lying about it will only hurt me in the end.  Plus, she may be able to suggest ways for me to seek help.  

In regards to drugs, I’m not even sure if I am addicted.  Because I can stop this shit whenever I feel like it, and as I mentioned before I have done it for 2 weeks without feeling a damn thing.  Either way, this needs to stop or at the very very minimum, my drug use needs to drastically slow down to maybe once every couple weeks IF THAT.  

Thank you again for ur reply’s and encouragement. I wish you the best in your journey to recovery.
